edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke's Bone Skewer (Q, 10-8s by rank) is matchup-defining — the hook starts the chain, his R (100/85/70s) cleans what it catches. Keep W Eclipse banked for his best play. The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
Interrupt Bone Skewer with your CC
Bone Skewer is a channel — Shield of Daybreak, Zenith Blade, and Solar Flare all cancel it outright the moment any of your CC lands.
Answer him with pure HP items
Gift of the Drowned Ones caps his max-HP scaling into bonus AD, and armor alone doesn't cap that damage — pair resistances with anti-heal, not health stacking.
